target_customer: Romantic couples who want AI coaching and daily connection activities
problem: Couples therapy is expensive and static relationship content does not adapt. Maia offers always available AI advice, quizzes and voice help.
business_model: Consumer subscription with in app purchases

founders.name: Claire Wiley
prior_employers: Tech and infrastructure private equity (firm not named on the YC page)
education: MBA (school not named on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says she launched a couples coaching program during her MBA.

founders.name: Ralph Ma
founders.background_notes: YC page names him as part of the team without a title or background. One secondary write up calls him a Google research scientist, which is unverified.

competitors.name: Couply
competitors.what: App with an AI personalized relationship coach
competitors.traction_then: Press release cites an app dataset from over 400,000 couples

technical_complexity.rationale: Chat and voice interfaces over hosted language models with relationship science prompts are standard consumer AI engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many couples AI apps launched at once and the product is easy to imitate. The only sourced differentiator is expert input to training.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed the wedge in sources; many small rivals appeared.

market_need_then: Couples therapy cost and access are real pains, and the YC launch post contrasts Maia with static content apps, but no dated demand figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses ourmaia.com, a prefix domain, not maia.com.

identity.visual_style: Clean layout with polaroid style couple photos and green and blue heart emojis on its launch post
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, upbeat and playful ('spice things up')

branding.brand_signature: Green and blue heart emoji pair on its YC launch post
branding.community_and_virality: Two Product Hunt launches (2023-12-05 with 107 upvotes, 2024-05-22 for the voice feature); the site lists press logos including TechCrunch but no article was found.

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found Product Hunt launches and directories only, and noted another product named Maia, so the name is not unique.

outcome_analysis: Maia is an active Winter 2024 YC company with apps on both stores and a voice feature launched in 2024. No outcome news was found, user numbers are not stated, and funding is unverified, so only product progress can be described. Many competing couples AI apps appeared in the same period.
notes: Aggregators report about $500K, with CB Insights listing a $0.5M convertible note dated 2024-04-04 and VCBacked and Extruct listing YC and North South Ventures; unverified so no round is recorded. Founding year differs by source (2023 per YC, 2022 PitchBook, 2024 another site). Only one dated competitor source near the batch was found. Completeness pass: The 500K dollar convertible note (stage other) rests on a single database (CB Insights, with PitchBook also logging a YC deal on 2024-04-04 and an undisclosed North South Ventures investment dated 2024-04-01).
